proposals.evidence: CDIAL 6914 nakha explicitly gives nahu/naũh and Palula nōṅg nail under its first branch; retained velar clusters there must not be mechanically reassigned to *nakkha. Chil nōr needs a local rhotic account. Reviewed comparator: MagahiNepal nau “fingernail” (f_6boqqdsnmgd66). Uncertain intra-IA transmission remains open; exact source text is preserved.
